Computes a placebo variant of our estimator using pre-treatment data only

Source: R/synthdid.R
sdid_placebo.Rd

Computes a placebo variant of our estimator using pre-treatment data only

Usage

sdid_placebo(estimate, treated.fraction = NULL, placebo.time = "auto")

Arguments

estimate

The result of sdid() with a single adoption period.

treated.fraction

The share of the periods before treatment that the placebo treats, counted back from the last of them. Defaults to NULL, which uses the share of all periods that are treated. Give either this or placebo.time, not both.

placebo.time

The period at which the placebo treatment begins, as it appears in the time column, such as 1981, or a date for a panel indexed by dates. It must come before the real treatment, with at least one period before it. Defaults to "auto", which sets it from treated.fraction.

Value

The placebo estimate, an object of the internal class sdid_estimate. It is a 1 by 1 matrix holding the estimated placebo effect, which c() turns into a number, with the attributes weights, holding the unit weights omega and time weights lambda, setup, the panel restricted to the periods before treatment, with the placebo starting at placebo.time, and opts, the settings of the fit. Printing it shows, on one line, the estimator, the estimate, the effective numbers of controls and of periods before the placebo, and the numbers of treated units and of periods after it. sdid_placebo_plot() draws it with the original estimate.
